headline: Rivier outscores every program in the GNEAC
dek: Rivier won fifteen matches against five losses and three draws, scoring 68 goals while conceding 22 across the season. With 21 different scorers contributing, the program outpaced every conference rival in front of goal.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the GNEAC is sharply top-heavy, with Rivier's 68 goals surpassing the combined totals of Colby-Sawyer and Saint Joseph's (Maine) while the middle of the conference clusters tightly and the bottom drops off steeply.
